rdfs:label: Derivation
rdfs:comment: A qualified PROV derivation — the node that qualifies a wasDerivedFrom link between a derived entity and its source (prov:entity) with the activity, usage, generation or role involved.
notes: Use to qualify a `prov:wasDerivedFrom` with role, generation, usage, or activity context (via `prov:qualifiedDerivation`). Specialized subclasses include `urn:solid:Revision` (substantive change), `urn:solid:Quotation` (excerpt), and `urn:solid:PrimarySource` (first-hand origin).

history.note: Comment no longer calls it an event; notes/seeAlso reference urn:solid:PrimarySource and qualification properties.
